/about.title: Heartbreakers Esports
/about.description: We break rivals. We claim titles. Competitive Roblox esports across Super Street Soccer, Dodgeball Zero, and Courtside Volleyball.
h1: BUILT TO COMPETE. BORN TO BREAK THROUGH.
p: Heartbreakers brings a relentless competitive mindset to the Roblox sports scene. From the street pitch to the volleyball court, we build teams that trust each other, put in the work, and thrive under pressure.
Every practice has a purpose. Every match is an opportunity.
Individual skill starts the play. Teamwork finishes it.
Respect the competition. Push the scene forward.
Roster players. Captains. Staff. We’re looking for talent, commitment, and a team-first mentality.
